name: non-hostname-cn-no-san-excluded-dns-valid
description: A leaf with no SAN and a non-hostname CN should be accepted under an excluded DNS subtree: the CN is not a DNS-form name and so the DNS constraint has no SAN or DNS-fallback name to evaluate. Mirrors non-hostname-cn-no-san-permitted-dns-valid - the question this case asks is whether the CN-fallback skip is symmetric between permitted and excluded. A validator that always runs CN-fallback (matching a non-hostname CN against an excluded DNS subtree as a literal string) would diverge by rejecting.
references: Go name_constraints_test "no SANs and non-hostname CN is accepted in constrained chain"
